texts.value: Transports retinoic acid to the nucleus. Regulates the access of retinoic acid to the nuclear retinoic acid receptors
Interacts with RXR and RARA (By similarity). Interacts with importin alpha

Forms a beta-barrel structure that accommodates hydrophobic ligands in its interior

Belongs to the calycin superfamily. Fatty-acid binding protein (FABP) family
